source: TI LMR51430 datasheet rev A sections 9.2 and 9.4; values are layout proxies

rationale.path_max_mm: 20 mm is an initial experimental locality limit, not a TI numerical requirement. This measures endpoint-connected centerline paths; polygonal pours and EMI/thermal performance need separate validation.
rationale.min_power_width_mm: 0.5 mm is an experimental geometry minimum, not an ampacity guarantee. Product current and copper thickness are unresolved.
rationale.fb_sw_separation_min_mm: Keeps the feedback sense network away from the switching node; it is a locality proxy, not a noise measurement.
